definitions.gloss: lively, vigorous, vibrant, full of energy
definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something full of energy, life, and vigor. Often implies youthful vitality and enthusiastic spirit.

examples.japanese: {溌剌|はつらつ}とした⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{溌剌|はつらつ}とした⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}した→挨拶する：01797_aisatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: She greeted me in a vibrant voice.

examples.japanese: {溌剌|はつらつ}とした⟦プレー→プレー：29432_puree⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{沸|わ}かせた→沸く：01122_waku⟧。
examples.english: The vigorous play excited the spectators.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Most commonly used as {溌剌|はつらつ}とした or {溌剌|はつらつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

ORTHOGRAPHY: The kanji {溌剌|はつらつ} uses rare characters. Often written in hiragana as はつらつ, especially in casual writing.

NUANCE: {溌剌|はつらつ} suggests energetic vitality, often with connotations of youth and freshness. It's more about physical/mental vigor than just a cheerful mood.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {溌剌|はつらつ}とした⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧ (lively youth)
- {溌剌|はつらつ}とした⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (vibrant voice)
- {溌剌|はつらつ}とした⟦プレー→プレー：29432_puree⟧ (vigorous play)
- {溌剌|はつらつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work energetically)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧ (energetic, healthy - more common)
- ⟦{活発|かっぱつ}→活発：13272_kappatsu⟧ (active, lively)
- ⟦{快活|かいかつ}→快活：09188_kaikatsu⟧ (cheerful, vivacious)
- ⟦{生|い}き{生|い}き→生き生き：10223_ikiiki⟧ (lively, vividly)
